inferred_requirements.title: Dual-Monitor Mirroring Restriction
inferred_requirements.description: The desktop examination sandbox must restrict and disable dual-monitor setups and screen mirroring during active examination sessions to prevent external viewing or capture.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly stated in the user prompt requiring the restriction of dual-monitor mirroring.

inferred_requirements.title: OS Clipboard Paste Interception
inferred_requirements.description: The desktop application must intercept and block OS-level clipboard paste operations while an examination session is active.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly stated in the user prompt requiring the interception of OS clipboard paste.

inferred_requirements.title: Low-Level Operating System Hook Integration for Clipboard Control
inferred_requirements.description: The sandbox must implement low-level OS hooks (e.g., Win32 API hooks on Windows, Accessibility/Quartz services on macOS) to intercept clipboard events system-wide rather than strictly within application focus.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Relying solely on application-level focus events leaves external hotkeys and background processes capable of injecting clipboard data. Why 2: Low-level operating system hooks must be registered to capture global keystrokes and clipboard access requests before they reach the OS buffer. Why 3: Mandatory invariant: Clipboard isolation must be absolute across the entire desktop environment during an active session to prevent data exfiltration or ingestion.

inferred_requirements.title: Display Enumeration and Topology Forcing
inferred_requirements.description: The sandbox runtime must enumerate connected display devices upon session initialization and force a single-display fallback or terminate execution if multiple active displays are detected.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Simply hiding an application window from a secondary display does not prevent OS-level screen mirroring or extension. Why 2: The platform display APIs must be queried at runtime to detect physical or virtual display topology changes. Why 3: Mandatory invariant: Active examinations must execute exclusively within a single, verified display constraint to comply with anti-mirroring policies.

inferred_requirements.title: Target Operating System Architecture Support
inferred_requirements.description: The specific target operating system versions (e.g., Windows 10/11, macOS versions, Linux distributions) and their corresponding sandbox implementation APIs are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: No specific OS versions or deployment platforms were mentioned in the prompt.

inferred_requirements.title: Exam Backend Telemetry and Session Sync Protocol
inferred_requirements.description: The network protocol, authentication mechanism, and backend endpoints used to report lockdown violations, session start/end states, and telemetry are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt specifies the local sandbox behavior but does not define any remote server integration, API schemas, or backend communication protocols.
